source.title: Impact Sounds
source.pageText: Kenney game asset pack: 130 impact and footstep sounds (metal, wood, plank, glass, soft, mining, plus footstep carpet/concrete/grass/snow/wood). All assets on kenney.nl are published under Creative Commons Zero (CC0).

evidenceNotes: Local license snapshot inside the pack (License.txt) and art/licenses/kenney_cc0_license.txt.
Footsteps continue existing surface pools via cross-asset variant numbering (concrete stands in for stone; wood continues the TinyWorlds wood pool).
